text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: METHODS AND PRACTICES FOR THE CURRENT DATE AND TIME." That last clause requires a live clock.
